routine.label: Routine Clean
routine.note: Every-visit tasks happen each time. As-needed tasks rotate through your schedule so nothing builds up.

rooms.name: Living Room & Common Areas
every: Clean entry and exit glass doors
Vacuum or sweep and mop accessible areas under furniture
Sweep and mop or vacuum all floors & rugs
Tidy areas, fold blankets & arrange pillows
asNeeded: Doors and door frames hand wiped
Window sills and ledges hand wiped

rooms.name: Kitchen & Dining
every: Clean and polish oven and stove exterior
Clean the interior & exterior of microwave
Clean stovetop, grates, burners & control panel
Sweep and mop or vacuum all floors & rugs
asNeeded: Drip pans or glass top surfaces cleaned
Doors and door frames hand wiped

rooms.name: Bedrooms
every: Vacuum or sweep and mop accessible areas under furniture
Sweep and mop or vacuum all floors & rugs
Tidy areas, fold blankets & arrange pillows
Make beds and change linens (if requested & left on bed)
asNeeded: Doors and door frames hand wiped
Window sills and ledges hand wiped

rooms.name: Bathrooms
every: Clean, disinfect & dry sinks, countertops, faucets & fixtures
Polish faucets & fixtures (towel racks, toilet paper holder, etc.)
Clean and scrub shower tiles, glass and tub
Clean and sanitize toilet and base
Sweep & mop floors, vacuum bath mats

deep.label: Deep Clean
deep.note: Everything in a routine clean, plus intensive detail work wherever buildup exists.

Wipe down doors, doorknobs & door frames
